description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget called ConsultationsScreen, which displays a list of consultations, handles loading and error states, and provides UI interactions such as refresh and adding new consultations (stub). It also includes a helper widget for displaying individual consultation items.

classes.name: ConsultationsScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that loads and displays a list of consultations, with refresh capability and a placeholder for adding new consultations.

classes.name: _ConsultationTile
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that displays a single consultation's details in a ListTile format.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes state and triggers fetching consultation data after the first frame.

methods.name: _refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the list of consultations by calling fetchAll on the provider.

methods.name: _createStub
methods.description: Shows a SnackBar indicating that consult creation is coming soon.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for the consultations list, handling loading, error, empty, and populated states.
